page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number top right. Main text in two columns of paired Italian/Latin verb forms (left column Italian, right column Latin), with interspersed headings and rubrics in centred and indented lines. Faint marginal ghost text on the right side of the page (show-through, not transcribed). Bottom right: small signature-like mark "h. iij." treated as running text end.

main_text.p:
Io hauési létto vtinam Ego legissem.
tu hauéssi létto tu legisses.
colúi hauésse létto ille legisset.
Nói hauéssimo létto Nos legissemus.
vói hauéste létto vos legissetis.
coló́ro hauéssero létto illi legissent.

Io haueréi, & haueria létto O' ego legissem.
tu hauerésti létto tu legisses.
colúi hauerébbe, & hauería
létto ille legisset.
Nói haueremmo létto Nos legissemus.
vói haueréste létto vos legissetis.
coloro hauerébbono, & haue-
riano létto illi legissent.

Io hauerò létto Quum ego legero.
tu hauerái létto tu legeris.
colúi hauerà létto ille legerit.
Nói hauerémo létto Nos legerimus.
vói haueréte létto vos legeritis.
coloro haueránno létto illi legerint.

page.notes: Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is visible on the right and was omitted. The first column entries "Io hauési" etc. are Italian verb forms as printed. The mark "h. iij." at lower right is a signature.
